data.validation_policy: The target is prediction for an unobserved operational configuration, defined exactly as the four non-frequency source features, not a new frequency row at an already observed configuration. Group identity is the pipe-joined original decimal tokens for those four fields; all rows with that exact tuple stay together. For reproducible audit use scikit-learn GroupShuffleSplit one split, test_size=.25, random_state=42, on all1503 original observations (joint internal row reordering is equivalent because selection is by unique configuration label). Fit the declared ordinary least-squares affine baseline on the five original numeric features and training rows only, without feature selection or target transforms; score row-weighted heldout RMSE in source scaled-sound-pressure dB. The existing report instead used unstratified scikit-learn train_test_split(test_size=.25,random_state=42) on rows; its observed partition labels are supplied for overlap auditing. Return the fraction of its test rows whose configuration also occurs in its training rows, whether that row-split score identifies the stated unknown-configuration error, and the new group-disjoint test sizes/RMSE. This is a fixed audit, not hyperparameter tuning or a causal physical model.
data.scientific_scope: Historical NASA wind-tunnel NACA0012 measurements. The operational equal-four-feature grouping is a declared evaluation unit, not a claim that it recovers every original experimental dependency. Neither split alone proves geographic, blade-design or all-future-flow transport. Features retain the source units; the source target is scaled sound pressure, not unscaled loudness or sound energy.

source_provenance.scientific_scope: NASA airfoil aeroacoustic measurements, wind-tunnel blade sections; source observations unmodified, no actual measurement invented.

data.export_transformation: All1503rows and all6numeric columns unchanged in original order. configuration_ids only serialize the exact four-field identity tuple. legacy_partition_records attach the declared historical audit split to row identities, not computed overlap conclusions or scientific answers.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
